question: Should OpenClaw land the Codex 0.143 app-server floor now, accepting that custom 0.142 app-servers are rejected and retired `on-failure` values are repaired to `on-request`?
rationale: The code matches the upstream 0.143 contract, but the merge intentionally changes upgrade behavior for custom app-server users and persisted approval-policy values, so a maintainer must own that compatibility choice.

options.title: Land 0.143 compatibility
options.body: Accept the floor bump and approval-policy migration as the correct Codex 0.143 compatibility path once exact-head checks are green.

options.title: Preserve 0.142 compatibility
options.body: Keep the lower protocol floor and add range compatibility if maintainers still want custom 0.142 app-server support through this release.

options.title: Hold for upgrade proof
options.body: Pause merge until a maintainer sees live upgrade proof for a custom server and a persisted `on-failure` binding/config.

recommendation.title: Land 0.143 compatibility
recommendation.body: Accept the floor bump and approval-policy migration as the correct Codex 0.143 compatibility path once exact-head checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned, authored the PR, and has recent Codex app-server/auth release history, making him the best available owner for the compatibility signoff.
